Type: square wood framed wall mirror
Use: decorating a wall, reflecting light; living room, bedroom, entryway, above a mantel
Style: rustic, farmhouse
Materials: distressed whitewashed wood with stepped moulding, mirror glass
Colors: warm tan wood, white wash
Shape: square, wide layered stepped frame, chunky and substantial, large
Feel: warm, cozy, weathered
Goes with: white walls, linen, natural textures, reclaimed wood; farmhouse or rustic rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Vintage-Look Square Hanging Wall Mirror, 39.5 Inch Height, Tan and White
product.description: A subtly white-washed wood frame gives this mirror a vintage feel, and rows of molding give it substantial depth and texture. Hang it in any bedroom, hallway or living room where you want to add a rustic touch. Subtle white-wash finish and wide molded frame create vintage appeal Glass with solid fir wood frame 31.5"W x 2.5"D x 31.5"H Avoid moisture. Wipes clean with soft, dry cloth. Hanging hardware not included.
